about: The core views of Pointe Sombre (Integrator-owned): the three atmospheres from one camera, the crossing deck, the island's shape, and the architecture fixture's interior cell. Each content cell adds Tools/Review/Lvl_PointeSombre/<cell>.json. VS-04 perf gate 0 is the average frame time over these views.

viewpoints.expectation: From the quay arrival point in the dusk storm (the new-game look): the island rises toward the tower rock on the Pointe, and its shape still reads as land against a storm sky, dark but not black.
The same view after the storm passes (calm evening): warmer, clearer, the far shore and the tower rock read further away; clearly a different time and weather from the storm, not just a brighter one.
viewpoints.source: VerticalSlicePhasePlan.txt §6 #8 (calm evening after knows); VS-04 atmosphere spike

viewpoints.expectation: The same view in the second storm, at night: dark and cold blue, the island's skyline still readable against the sky so a lit tower would read later.
viewpoints.source: VerticalSlicePhasePlan.txt §6 #8 (night storm after the meeting); VS-04 atmosphere spike

viewpoints.expectation: From the Ida's deck (stub) in the storm: open water ahead, the island low on the horizon to the north-east; the deck and rail read as a vessel, not a floating box.

A high oblique from the south in the calm look: the whole island frame at once, the harbor and quay on the south shore, the tower rock on the Pointe to the east, the headland to the west, the reef causeway out to the Grey's reef.
From the settlement terrace in the storm: the tower rock on the Pointe is the highest thing in view and pulls the eye.
Inside the architecture fixture's interior cell: a closed concrete room lit only by its own lamp (no sun on the floor or walls), ceiling and walls all present, the door out ahead.
viewpoints.source: VS-04 cell-placement rule (lighting channel 1, own grade); Tools/EditorScripts/pointe_sombre/arch_test.py

viewpoints.expectation: Looking up inside the same room: a lit concrete ceiling, no sky and no void.
viewpoints.source: VS-04 cell-placement rule; rendered portal check 2026-10-01 showed a black band above the walls

route.expectation: Walking up from the quay toward the tower rock in the storm: continuous ground, the rock ahead, nothing floating.
